title: 1985 AHSME Problem 13
statement: Pegs are put in a board \(1\) unit apart both horizontally and vertically. A rubber band is stretched over \(4\) pegs as shown in the figure, forming a quadrilateral. Its area in square units is

solutions.text: With the lower-left peg as \((0,0),\) the quadrilateral’s vertices in order are \((1,3),\) \((4,1),\) \((3,0),\) and \((0,1).\) The shoelace formula gives \[ \begin{aligned} &\frac12\left|(1+0+3+0)\right.\\ &\quad\left.{}-(12+3+0+1)\right|=6. \end{aligned} \] Therefore the correct answer is E.
hints: Assign integer coordinates to the four corner pegs
Use the shoelace formula on \((1,3),\) \((4,1),\) \((3,0),\) and \((0,1)\)
